auth.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

dashboard.subtitle: Workshop status on {date}
dashboard.cashMovementHelp: Money actually received and paid out (excluding transfers between accounts). This is not profit.
dashboard.salesHelp: Confirmed orders are recorded sales, not money received.
dashboard.expensesHelp: Wage advances are not counted as expenses.

onboarding.title: Welcome! Let's get started
onboarding.subtitle: A few steps to set up the workshop. You can do them in any order.

opening.title: Enter the cash on hand
opening.help: Record the opening balance of the cash box (and the bank if needed).

workers.title: Add workers
workers.help: Name, craft and pay arrangement (weekly, daily, per piece or negotiated).

customers.title: Add a customer
customers.help: A name and a phone number are enough.

orders.title: Create an order
orders.help: Negotiated price, delivery date and any deposit.

advances.title: Record a msrouf
advances.help: Every advance given during the week, in seconds.

settings.title: Set up the workshop
settings.help: Workshop name, first day of the week, accounts.

workers.description: The workshop's artisans and workers, their pay and balance.
workers.arrangementHelp: How this worker is paid. Each week's amount can be adjusted when paying.
workers.defaultDaysHint: Used to propose the week's amount.
workers.negotiatedHelp: The amount is agreed each week, at payment time.
workers.emptyHelp: Add your artisans to track their advances and pay.
workers.balanceHelp: Every amount comes from the movements listed below.
workers.balancePositive: Amount the workshop still owes the worker.
workers.balanceNegative: Negative amount: the worker received more than their recorded pay.
workers.deactivateConfirm: The worker will no longer appear in day-to-day lists. All history is kept.
workers.inactiveNotice: This worker is deactivated: no new advance or payment can be recorded.
workers.pendingHelp: Msrouf given in weeks whose pay is not confirmed yet. It will be deducted at settlement.

payroll.description: For each worker: the week's pay, msrouf already given, payments and remaining balance.
payroll.formula: Remaining = agreed pay + adjustments − the week's msrouf (wage advances) − the week's payments.
payroll.paymentHelp: Partial payment is allowed. The rest stays owed.
payroll.baseNotRecorded: This week's pay is not confirmed yet. It will be recorded with this payment.
payroll.agreedThisWeekHint: Change it if the week was shorter or different.
payroll.businessAdvancesNote: Money given for workshop purchases (not deducted from pay):
payroll.carryForward: Carry the balance to next week
payroll.carryConfirm: This week's balance will be moved to next week. The worker's total balance does not change.
payroll.noEarnings: No pay lines for this week
payroll.voidHelp: The line stays visible, struck through, with the reason. Use this to fix an entry mistake.

advances.description: All advances given to workers (msrouf), by day and category.
advances.newHelp: Quick entry: worker and amount, that's it. Everything else is pre-filled.
advances.savedDetail: Advance {reference} recorded for the week of {week}
advances.allocateHint: Default: the week of the advance date.
advances.businessHelp: Counted as expenses, never deducted from pay.

advanceTreatment.wageHelp: Will be deducted from the week's pay.
advanceTreatment.businessHelp: Money for the workshop (e.g. buying leather). Does not reduce pay.

orders.description: Customer orders, from negotiation to delivery.
orders.boardHelp: Orders in progress, by stage. Use the buttons to move them forward.
orders.linesLocked: Production has started: the price is no longer edited here. Use a documented discount or surcharge on the order.
orders.depositHint: A deposit never marks the order as paid.
orders.deliverUnpaidConfirm: The customer has not paid in full. The balance will remain due after delivery. Continue?
orders.cancelHelp: History and payments are kept. Any refund is recorded separately afterwards.
orders.cancellationFeeHint: E.g. the retained deposit. The rest must be refunded.
orders.adjustmentHint: Negative amount for a discount, positive for a surcharge.
orders.noPaymentsHelp: Deposits and payments will appear here.
orders.quickPaymentHelp: Choose the order and enter the amount received.

customers.description: Your customers, their orders and what they owe.
customers.similarFound: A similar customer already exists (same name or same phone).
customers.createAnyway: This is a different customer, create anyway
customers.balanceFormula: Balance = total of orders − payments + refunds.
customers.creditNote: Negative balance: the workshop owes this customer money.
customers.deactivateConfirm: The customer will be hidden from lists. Orders and payments are kept.

expenses.description: Workshop purchases and costs. Wage advances are not included.
expenses.byCategoryHelp: Includes money given to workers for workshop purchases.
expenses.reimbursedWorkerHint: If a worker paid out of pocket. Does not affect their pay.

cash.description: The workshop's money, calculated from every recorded movement.
cash.calculatedHelp: Sum of money in minus money out.
cash.countHelp: Count the money actually present and compare it with the calculated amount.
cash.recordAdjustment: Record the difference as an adjustment
cash.recordAdjustmentHint: A visible, dated adjustment movement is created. Nothing is overwritten.
cash.otherIncomeHelp: Money received that does not come from an order (e.g. an untracked counter sale).
cash.openingHelp: The money present when you start using the app, once per account.
cash.transferHelp: Move money (e.g. a bank deposit). Neither income nor expense.
cash.reconciliationHelp: Comparison between counted money and the calculated amount.

ledger.title: Movement journal
ledger.description: Every money movement in order. Nothing is erased: corrections are visible reversals.
ledger.reverseHelp: An opposite movement will be created. The original stays visible. Balances are recalculated.
ledger.immutableNote: Movements cannot be edited or deleted. To correct one, reverse it and enter it again.

reports.description: Every report is calculated from recorded movements and can be exported to CSV or printed.
reports.truncated: The report is limited to 20,000 rows: shorten the period.
reports.noProfitNote: The app does not calculate a "net profit": it keeps money received, recorded sales, customer receivables, amounts owed to workers and expenses separate.

cash-flow.title: Money in and out
cash-flow.description: Opening balance, money in, money out and closing balance per account.
cash-flow.explanation: For each account: balance before the period, plus money in, minus money out during the period. Transfers between accounts appear on both sides and cancel out in the total.

financial-activity.title: Financial journal
financial-activity.explanation: Complete list of recorded movements, reversals included. A reversal appears as an opposite movement.

expenses-by-category.title: Expenses by category
expenses-by-category.description: Workshop purchases and costs in the period.
expenses-by-category.explanation: Recorded expenses plus money given to workers for workshop purchases, minus reversals. Wage advances and worker payments are not included.

customer-payments.title: Customer payments
customer-payments.description: Deposits, payments and refunds received or made.
customer-payments.explanation: Customer payments as money in and refunds as money out, dated on the day of payment.

customer-balances.title: Customer balances
customer-balances.description: What each customer still owes (or is owed).
customer-balances.explanation: Agreed total of orders (cancellation fee for cancelled orders) − payments + refunds.

orders-by-status.title: Orders by status
orders-by-status.description: Number and value of orders created in the period.
orders-by-status.explanation: Orders whose order date is in the period, grouped by current status.

order-value.title: Order value
order-value.description: Recorded sales (confirmed orders) in the period.
order-value.explanation: Orders that are not cancelled and not quotes, by order date. This is the agreed value, not money received.

overdue-orders.title: Overdue orders
overdue-orders.description: Undelivered orders past their expected date.
overdue-orders.explanation: Orders neither delivered nor cancelled whose expected delivery date is before today.

worker-payments.title: Worker payments
worker-payments.explanation: Settlement payments (excluding msrouf), net of reversals, dated on the day of payment.

advances.title: Msrouf by worker
advances.description: Wage advances and purchase money, per worker.
advances.explanation: Advances dated in the period, net of reversals, split between wage advances (deducted from pay) and workshop purchases.

weekly-settlement.title: Weekly settlement
weekly-settlement.description: Pay, msrouf, payments and remaining balance for each worker.
weekly-settlement.explanation: Remaining = agreed pay + adjustments − the week's msrouf − the week's payments. Pay not yet confirmed is proposed from the worker's arrangement.

worker-balances.title: Worker balances
worker-balances.description: What the workshop still owes each worker.
worker-balances.explanation: Sum over all weeks of recorded pay minus msrouf and payments. Negative: the worker received more than their recorded pay. The "Msrouf to deduct" column shows advances in weeks whose pay is not confirmed yet.

reconciliation.title: Cash counts
reconciliation.description: Comparison between counted money and the calculation.
reconciliation.explanation: Difference = counted amount − amount calculated at the time of the count. An adjusted difference creates a visible adjustment movement.

print.situationAtPrint: Situation at the time of printing.
print.disclaimer: Internal workshop document. This receipt is not a payslip or an invoice.

settings.description: Workshop settings, users, accounts and categories.
settings.weekStartDay: First day of the pay week
settings.weekStartHint: Msrouf and payments are grouped by week starting on this day.
settings.weekStartLocked: Can no longer change: pay weeks are already recorded.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings.usersHelp: People who can sign in. Workers do not have accounts.
settings.passwordReset: Password reset. The user was signed out.
settings.managerPermissions: What a manager / accountant can do
settings.ownerOnly: Owner only: opening balances, transfers, cash adjustments, refunds, movement reversals, voiding pay lines, accounts, categories, users, settings and the audit log.
settings.accountsHelp: Where the money is kept (workshop cash box, bank…).
settings.categoriesHelp: Worker crafts and item categories. Add new products here.
settings.auditHelp: Who created or changed what, and when.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.overpayment: The amount is more than what remains to be paid.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Nothing was saved.

detail.worker_code: this worker code is already used
detail.email: this email address is already used
detail.base_pay_exists: this week's pay is already recorded
detail.base_pay_input: enter the days, pieces or amount for the week
detail.exceeds_remaining: the payment is more than the week's remaining balance
detail.exceeds_balance: the payment is more than the order's balance
detail.refund_exceeds_paid: the refund is more than the customer paid
detail.note_required: a note is required for an adjustment
detail.transition: this status change is not possible
detail.file_type: file type not accepted (JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF)
detail.self_lockout: you cannot remove your own owner access
detail.negative_total: the order total would become negative

validation.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
validation.customerRequired: Choose a customer or create one.
validation.dueBeforeOrder: Delivery cannot be before the order date.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.help: This page does not exist or has moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.help: Nothing was changed. Try again; if the problem continues, note the time and contact the person who manages the app.
